question: What does the warranty on your invisible grills in Chennai actually cover?
answer:
At GCM Netting Solutions Chennai, we stand behind the quality and durability of our invisible grills. Our warranty covers manufacturing defects and premature failure of the HDPE material used in our grills. This high-density polyethylene (HDPE) is UV stabilized to withstand the harsh Chennai sun and weather conditions, ensuring long-lasting performance. Typically, our warranty ranges from 3 to 5 years, depending on the specific product and installation.

The warranty covers the replacement or repair of the netting should it become damaged due to manufacturing defects or premature degradation under normal usage conditions. It's important to note that the warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, alterations, or natural disasters. Our professional installation is crucial for ensuring the validity of the warranty, as improper installation can compromise the integrity of the safety nets. We pride ourselves on our expert installation services across Chennai, ensuring your safety nets are fitted correctly and securely.
